assumptions: End-effector Jacobians and joint torque limits are available in simulation.
Lower-body locomotion and upper-body joint tracking form separable objectives with shared proprioception.
environments: 252 ACCAD targets under three force levels

confidence_rationale: Controlled force-level, architecture and torque-aware curriculum comparisons plus a small real-robot quantitative test and public implementation support the mechanism. Confidence is capped by limited real quantitative scope and approximate force feasibility.

evidence.note: Defines force feasibility and compares dual-agent, monolithic, IK/PD and curriculum variants.
Maps torque-aware force and curriculum mechanisms to official code.

question: 受力移动操作训练中应如何生成末端扰动？
statement: 在 FALCON 的 G1/T1 设置中，按末端 Jacobian、重力力矩和关节力矩余量限制三维扰动，并逐步扩大其尺度，配合共享观测的上下身双策略，可比无力矩感知扰动、上身 PD/IK 和同栈单体全身 RL 获得更低受力跟踪误差；该静态近似不等于实机接触或热安全保证。
